confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and city context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Dining and cafe anchors are better characterised than hostel and hotel rates, which vary by season and are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly from typical Beijing bar and restaurant prices and sanity-checked against the beer anchor, not derived from it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect Beijing's own price level as a tier-one Chinese capital and major tourist destination, cross-checked against other large Chinese cities such as Shanghai.
